## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Let `Peers(network)` join an `InMemoryPeerNetwork` under the agent's `name`, and rename `PeerNetwork` to `PeerConnection` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/13777
* Add `StavProvider` for the Stav European inference gateway by @bwentzel in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12750
* Add Otari as an OpenAI-compatible gateway provider by @tbille in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/13584
* Add `auth` to `StackOne`, deprecating `api_key`, to match the other hosted MCP capabilities by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/13735
* Add `grep_tool_result` and `unit='bytes'` reads for `ToolOutputLimits` spills by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/13752
* Run remote `CodeMode` turns as Temporal activities so long snippets don't trip the deadlock detector by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/13756
* Add `DeferredToolRequests.validated_args` so an approver sees the arguments a deferred tool call will
